diagnosis: The financial metrics endpoint runs an Elasticsearch aggregation to calculate total revenue and average invoice size. While the user is authenticated, the query is not scoped by organizationId or tenantId. Any tenant user can discover global financial metrics and total transaction volumes across the entire multi-tenant platform.
exploit_request:
GET /api/analytics/invoices/summary?fiscalYear=2025 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.b2bfinances.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_user_token>
